stories.title: 'How EC gave him info is a mystery': Akhilesh on Yogi's 1.27 crore Hindu voters deleted claim
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav has voiced significant alarm over Yogi Adityanath's assertion that 1.27 crore Hindu voters were removed from the electoral rolls. He questions the legitimacy of how Adityanath accessed this information from the Election Commission. Yadav suggests that this statement aims to incite fear among voters and indicates some underlying conspiracy.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Microsoft struggles to restore services after 16-hour outage; 23 killed in Kaziranga crash & more
Women at the controls, solar power on the rooftops: What makes Pune Metro's Pink Line special
Mysuru’s growing place in the global Ayurveda and wellness landscape
stories.summary: The Indus Valley Ayurvedic Centre’s growing international reach reflects Mysuru’s emergence as a wellness destination. With global recognition, international certification and a focus on skilled local employment, the centre is helping shape the city’s place in India’s Ayurveda tourism landscape.

stories.title: 'No final decision yet': Bhujbal says NCP merger talks at preliminary stage
From helping fishermen to tracking trains: PM Modi highlights how space missions improve lives
Times Hospitality Icons Jaipur celebrates quality and innovation in hospitality
'No NCP merger talks': Maharashtra minister Bharne after meeting Sunetra Pawar
Court upholds contractual payments: ex-husband must keep paying fuel, health cover
stories.summary: A Louisiana appeals court has upheld a legal agreement requiring a divorced husband to keep paying his ex-wife's expenses. The court ruled these payments represent contractual duties rather than typical spousal support subject to change upon remarriage. Previous agreements concerning property and payments have been recognized, and the validity of the house deed has been affirmed. Both parties will bear the appeal costs, and either party can seek a rehearing.

stories.title: New York man gets up to 21 years for stealing $4.7 million Harlem homes
stories.summary: Joseph Makhani has been sentenced to seven to 21 years in prison for using forged documents to steal two Harlem brownstones worth $4.7 million. His scheme left an elderly homeowner living in a homeless shelter while he collected more than $12,000 in monthly rent from one of the properties.

stories.title: Sam Heughan Backs Arts Students: Outlander star funds RCS scholarships; Write Start boosts new creative projects
stories.summary: Sam Heughan is investing in the future of the arts by funding three scholarships annually for undergraduates at the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland. In addition, he launched Write Start: The Sam Heughan Creative Commission to inspire creativity in student projects. These scholarships help alleviate financial difficulties for students, reflecting Heughan's deep-rooted ties to the institution where he trained, and offering vital support to the next generation of artists.

stories.title: Missing for 50 years, original Yes album cover painting returns; Roger Dean's 'Fragile' artwork to go under hammer for £75,000
stories.summary: Yes' iconic album 'Fragile' cover painting was returned to its creator Roger Dean after being missing for nearly 50 years. Art Recovery International successfully negotiated the painting's return following a suspicious claim by a collector. The original artwork will be auctioned on December 2, 2026, with an estimated value of £75,000. Dean noted that he recognized the painting, despite noticing some changes over the years.

stories.title: Indiana court backs daughter as sole representative of father's estate after family dispute
stories.summary: An Indiana appeals court has upheld the removal of Rebecca Johnson as co-administrator of Shane Fields' estate after disputes over estate management and legal representation. Fields died in a 2025 Kentucky road accident, leaving a wife and five children. The court found that Johnson's refusal to follow court orders and cooperate with the other representative delayed the estate's legal claims. His daughter, Hailey Daniels, will remain the sole administrator.

stories.title: 'My phone tapped': Rahul fires salvo at PM Modi; 'get head examined', says BJP
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi accused PM Narendra Modi of having his phone tapped and renewed his challenge for a face-to-face debate. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav backed his allegation, saying technology could not be trusted in the age of AI. The BJP rejected the charge, with Kerala BJP chief Rajeev Chandrasekhar hitting back at the Congress leader.

stories.title: Families across 43 US states could get refunds, debt relief after rent-to-own deals advertised as 90-day plans allegedly doubled costs
stories.summary: In a significant development, consumers in 43 US states will receive a total of $183.5 million in refunds and debt relief from Acima Digital, following allegations of deceptive advertising linked to rental-purchase agreements. This settlement promises automatic restitution and lease forgiveness for those affected, alongside a commitment from Acima to improve their advertising transparency, pending court approval in Pennsylvania.

stories.title: 'Hopeful they will come': India on inviting Pakistan to SCO Civilisational Forum in Delhi
stories.summary: India has invited Pakistan to participate in the inaugural SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi. This event is scheduled to take place from November 20 to 22, featuring various participating countries. Union culture minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat expressed hope that Pakistan would attend the forum. The discussions will focus on cultural ties and shared civilisational heritage among member states.

stories.title: Kulgam terror attack: Several suspects picked up for questioning after strike on CRPF post
74 militants killed in Pakistan security operations along Afghan border in 10 days
US court orders release of Cuban father held by ICE for nearly six months
stories.summary: A federal court in Kentucky ordered ICE to release Cuban national Damichel Jesus Viamontes Castellano after finding that authorities had detained him for nearly six months without following mandatory custody review and notice procedures.

stories.title: Zedd sells Hollywood Hills home to fans for $4.25M
stories.summary: Grammy-winning DJ and producer Zedd has sold his Hollywood Hills home for $4.25 million recently. The four-bedroom house was listed initially for $5.5 million in October 2025 after several price reductions. The buyers, fans of Zedd, plan to convert his recording studio into a cinema space. Zedd had owned the property for over a decade after purchasing it for $3.9 million in 2014.

stories.title: Ohio court rules $350,000 farm sale proceeds go to heirs named in woman's will, not deed beneficiaries
stories.summary: In Ohio, the unexpected death of Eleanor M. Hovanick has led to a court ruling that the proceeds from her farm sale must go to her heirs as stipulated in her will. Despite having established a transfer-on-death deed for beneficiaries, the binding sale contract transformed her stake into a right to payment, altering the inheritance process.

stories.title: NASA crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid in 2022; Europe's Hera probe reaches impact site to investigate if Earth can be saved from space rocks
stories.summary: ESA's Hera spacecraft has initiated its observations of the Didymos asteroid system following NASA's DART mission's collision with Dimorphos. This investigation seeks to analyze the impact's effects on Dimorphos' structure and its trajectory, which is essential for planetary defense. Researchers aim to uncover the momentum enhancement factor and physical effects of the collision, while also deploying CubeSats for comprehensive data collection on both asteroids.

stories.title: 'India showed world yoga': PM Modi praises HV Sheshadri at Bengaluru event
'No long speeches': Rahul Gandhi renews debate challenge to PM Modi with a 'guarantee'
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi has renewed his challenge for a public debate with Prime Minister Narendra Modi during an Instagram session. He claimed he was unable to speak freely in Parliament and called for direct allegations against each other. Gandhi suggested a debate moderated by a neutral party, including options like RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat. BJP leaders dismissed his calls, emphasizing that Parliament serves as an appropriate platform for discussions.

stories.title: Appeal Extends Property Dispute: Alabama Power appeals; easement case remains unresolved
stories.summary: A legal clash continues between Alabama Power and landowner Fenn Church over a transmission line easement. Alabama Power has appealed to the state Supreme Court after a judge refused its request for a temporary restraining order. Church is disputing the compensation for the easement while contesting the company's access to his property, as the work to construct a 74-mile transmission line faces potential delays threatening its May 2027 completion.

stories.title: Bearadise Halloween Attraction: Florida DIY haunt grows to 5,000 sq ft; adds Salem witch-trial history
stories.summary: Bearadise in Orange Park has evolved from a simple display into a beloved Halloween destination over the years. Crafted by Matt McCary, this immersive attraction features a graveyard, eerie tombstones, and haunting sound effects. With a nod to history, QR codes reveal insights about the Salem witch trials, ensuring an educational twist. This community-driven experience attracts around 250 trick-or-treaters annually, solidifying its status as a cherished neighborhood tradition.

stories.title: 18th Annual Gala: Toronto event raises over $700,000; gang violence disrupts Haiti students’ schooling
stories.summary: Olivia Wilde's collaboration with Artists for Peace and Justice is pivotal in revolutionizing educational access for Haitian children. Following the devastating earthquake in 2010, the organization launched a free school in Port-au-Prince and now assists over 1,400 students each year. Despite ongoing gang violence hindering educational efforts, recent fundraising initiatives have generated substantial support, underscoring the vital need for continued investment in children's education and healthcare in Haiti.

stories.title: Nostalgic Brisbane Home Purchase: Buyer pays A$4.9m for childhood Queenslander; sale bucks weak auction market
stories.summary: A remarkable Queenslander residence located in Newmarket, Brisbane, was sold for A$4.9 million following an auction. The buyer, who has local roots, had no intention of bidding initially but ultimately decided to secure the property. This six-bedroom home, featuring expansive views of the city, marks a significant sale in a currently sluggish property market influenced by rising interest rates and borrowing challenges.

stories.title: Army vehicle carrying 14 personnel hits tree after losing control; 8 jawans injured
'Don't fall into BJP's trap': Raj Thackeray alleges bid to divide Mumbai over Chhath Puja

Nicola Forrest gives $500 million to help Indigenous children and women founders
Delhi govt alleges plot to dump dead fish in Yamuna ahead of Chhath Puja, seeks FIR
Montana photographer leaves 480 acres, $1 million gift to fund Alzheimer’s research in hometown after his death
stories.summary: Arnold Swanberg, a Montana-born photographer, donated 480 acres of farmland to the Weissman Hood Institute. The farmland will continue to be leased, and proceeds will support Alzheimer's research in Great Falls, Montana. Swanberg had personal connections to neurodegenerative diseases, influencing his decision to help research in this area. His donation is one of the largest in the institute's history and reflects his commitment to Montana.

stories.title: Europe plans to heat 6,500 homes and a school using crematorium heat
stories.summary: Redditch Borough Council's innovative plan to use waste heat from a crematorium to warm a swimming pool is gaining traction. This project has generated significant discussions and recognition for its environmental benefits since 2013. Similar initiatives are emerging in Scotland and Finland, aiming to utilize crematoriums for heating schools and residential areas. Experts indicate this approach could be vital in addressing heating demands and reducing carbon footprints.

stories.title: Railways looking into eliminating RAC for train journey
stories.summary: Railways is reviewing the Reservation Against Cancellation (RAC) facility due to passenger discomfort during travel. The existing system charges full fares for shared berths, raising concerns about fairness. Issues arise, particularly when male and female passengers share the same berth space, leading to uncomfortable situations. A parliamentary panel has also recommended the review of this arrangement for better passenger experience.

stories.title: Centre extends ban on Zakir Naik's Islamic Research Foundation for 5 years
'We have given up violence': Former Maoist leader Deoji seeks ban on CPI (Maoist) lifted, eyes democratic politics
'From armed struggle to people's politics': Ex-Maoist leader Deoji outlines new path, seeks release of jailed cadres
stories.summary: Former CPI(Maoist) leader Deoji is pivoting towards engaging in democratic politics, discarding his previous reliance on armed struggle. Now pursuing a law degree in Hyderabad, he is vocal about the need to remove the ban on CPI(Maoist) and seeks broad amnesty for Maoists in custody. He asserts that counter-Naxal initiatives have harmed their cause and expresses a vision for a society characterized by equity and freedom from exploitation.

stories.title: India makes gains against TB, deaths down 38% since 2015: Centre
stories.summary: India's estimated TB deaths declined by 38% between 2015 and 2025, signaling significant progress in controlling the disease. The treatment success rate for drug-susceptible TB reached 94%, supported by innovative diagnostic methods and comprehensive patient care. The ongoing TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan effectively identified nearly 15 lakh asymptomatic TB cases throughout the campaign. Despite progress, drug-resistant TB remains a challenge, with a notable treatment gap.

stories.title: Rs 81 lakh property of PoK terror handler seized in J&K's Rajouri
75 PG admissions stuck across 72 institutes; MCC reopens portal for a day
Urine biomarker may offer new way to flag cancer risk in India, study suggests
Trump backed Huang till end, urged him to fight for job amid China spy scandal
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump urged Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang to fight to retain his job shortly before his exit amid a China spy scandal, NYT reported. Trump continued backing Huang despite intelligence warnings about his alleged affair with a Chinese woman suspected of spying for Beijing. Bloomberg reported that Huang later called Trump and expressed remorse over the scandal's impact on his family.

stories.title: 18-year-old Asa Miller won 2025 Barron Prize for restoring Cuba's coral reefs
Pennsylvania governor and neighbours sue each other over disputed land ownership
Start a cab rental firm with 5 cars: Govt proposes major rule overhaul
Rs 10 lakh fine slapped on Ola for ‘tip to ride’ nudge
'Well done, specialist': Hegseth honours soldier who scolded his team at war memorial
stories.summary: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth presented Specialist Thomas Iglesias with the Joint Service Commendation Medal for his actions. This award was given for reminding officials to maintain silence and respect at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on Veterans Day. Iglesias's reprimand of Hegseth and aides was captured in a video widely shared on social media.

stories.title: Montana Supreme Court rules 10 extra driving miles aren't enough to change a father's custody plan
stories.summary: The Montana Supreme Court has reaffirmed a previous ruling on a parenting plan modification initiated by Justin Aikins, who sought changes after his ex-wife moved a mere 10 miles away. The court concluded that minor increases in distance do not justify altering existing custody arrangements. Attempts at mediation were unsuccessful, and this decision establishes an important precedent regarding relocations and shared parenting in Montana.

stories.title: A London financier lost his £2.6 million claim to his mother's Chelsea home
Homeowner accused of cutting down over 16 mature trees for a better ocean view
Oklahoma homeowner fined $8,528 as Supreme Court restores ban on his short-term rental business
stories.summary: A recent ruling by the Supreme Court has imposed a hefty fine of over $8,000 on an Oklahoma homeowner, Adewale Eniola Tawose. This decision reinstates the community's ban on short-term rentals after a legal tussle. Tawose's attempts to host guests led the homeowners association to act against him, reversing an earlier judgment that allowed his rental business, thus affirming the penalties and restrictions on such properties.

stories.title: Indians top again: 9.3L get OECD citizenships in 5 years
An endangered leatherback turtle tried to nest on an Ecuador sidewalk before finding a quieter beach
stories.summary: Bella, a resilient leatherback turtle, made a remarkable nesting attempt in Ecuador, overcoming an array of challenges posed by artificial lighting. Her successful hatchling rates reveal a promising trend, indicating that leatherbacks are beginning to adapt to their new coastal environments. Conservation efforts are increasingly vital as these turtles face persistent threats, highlighting the urgent need to establish safe habitats for their upcoming nesting seasons.

stories.title: Sheikh’s wife loses £8.3 million London mansion battle over Islamic gift claim
Rajasthan SSR draft counts 11 lakh more voters than SIR list
Indiana man loses pedal-pub injury lawsuit after appeals court upholds signed waiver
Researchers turn discarded wind turbine blades into graphene-rich material for newer ones
stories.summary: Wind turbine blades are challenging to dispose of due to their long-lasting materials, which complicate recycling efforts. A research team from Tsinghua University has created a method for transforming discarded blades into silicon carbide and graphene. The process requires a rapid temperature increase using electrical pulses, which is effective in material recovery.

stories.title: Woman's 32-day Airbnb stay turned into months-long legal battle in Washington
Tie-up with SAD likely, BJP may seek larger share of pie
New York court rejects man's $120,000 lawsuit against former fiancée over breakup
Fake funeral fundraiser showed $16,000, but Atlanta family got nothing
Texas man loses bid to keep gifted house as court awards wife $411,000 home and $175,000
stories.summary: A Texas divorce appeal has shed light on property disputes between Joshua Peacock and Stephanie Ann Samples. The court confirmed that a rental property and a family business must be classified as community property. While Peacock asserted that the rental house was a gift from his father, he did not provide adequate proof.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath: Bulldozers now UP brand, make them here
Scientists discovered a new orange-spotted fish which may already be on the brink of extinction
stories.summary: Researchers have unveiled Laimosemion laranja, a newly discovered species of killifish native to three isolated pools in Brazil. Facing grave threats from mining, deforestation, and urban pollution, this species is at risk of extinction. Through meticulous examinations and genetic analysis, scientists confirmed its uniqueness. To preserve this remarkable fish, they urge prompt protective measures to enhance its habitat and ensure its survival in the wild.

stories.title: Sam Pitroda, PM Modi display rare public bonhomie
Some people think democracy is in their pockets, says PM Modi
Government confident of holding polls in violence-hit Manipur on time

Sudden death of 27-year-old daughter of British actress Lisa Maxwell in New York. Columbia University issues statement
Texas appeals court overturns order barring granddaughter from family trust property
stories.summary: A Texas appeals court has dissolved an order barring a granddaughter from coming within 500 feet of family trust property. The court found that the lower court had failed to set a trial date and specify the required security amount. However, the wider dispute over control of the Barbara Tolbert Revocable Trust and the family's inheritance claims remains unresolved.

stories.title: Swiss surgeon reclaims Guinness record with 3,200 heart-shaped objects after losing it in 2024
stories.summary: Diana Reser, a renowned Swiss heart surgeon, proudly holds the record for the largest collection of heart-shaped artifacts, now boasting 3,200 pieces. Her passion began during her medical studies, spurred by thoughtful gifts from loved ones. Reser's eclectic assortment features both decorative items and functional accessories, while she actively champions heart health awareness. Currently, she's on the lookout for a unique heart-shaped shower head to enhance her collection.

stories.title: Stable Oxoboranes Isolated: Würzburg PhD pair trap rare bond; accident unlocks new chemistry
stories.summary: Two doctoral students at the University of Würzburg discovered stable oxoboranes, which contain a triple bond between boron and oxygen. Their findings emerged while studying reactions with diboracumulene and ketones, producing unexpected yellow and orange solids. The three new compounds can be isolated as crystalline solids and remain stable at room temperature. This breakthrough may allow greater exploration of their properties and reactions beyond previous limitations.

stories.title: Texas turned a demolished 6,620-foot bridge into a 320-acre artificial reef
Kashmiri wazas stir Valley pot with 10 pm wazwan deadline, politics takes back seat

Marco Rubio spent over $1.2m in taxpayer-funded flights to attend son's college games
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is facing scrutiny over his frequent trips to Florida to watch his son play college football, with a Washington Post investigation estimating that 23 military aircraft journeys cost taxpayers more than $1.2 million. While Rubio is required to use government aircraft for security reasons, the frequency of his personal trips has raised questions about taxpayer spending and official accountability.

stories.title: After EASA concern, Air India asks crew to remain on board till replacement arrives during Europe fuelling halts
Australian activists ordered to destroy abattoir footage despite retaining copyright
stories.summary: Australia’s High Court has concluded that Farm Transparency International maintains copyright over clandestinely acquired footage, underscoring the ramifications of trespassing despite its public interest nature. Activists are compelled to dispose of the recordings, although third parties may share them legally. This landmark judgment will influence future activism and the interplay of copyright law, prompting legal experts to scrutinize the ramifications for the rights of undercover filming.

stories.title: Australia's High Court overturns $1.346 million abuse compensation award, orders new tria
stories.summary: Australia’s High Court has ordered a retrial in the case concerning the estate of a convicted sexual abuser. The retrial is necessary after the first trial did not adequately address key pieces of evidence. The court clarified important legal principles related to unrepresented litigants and trial procedures. MTH, the survivor, is once again pursuing damages for the abuse she suffered while in foster care.

stories.title: Three school colleagues receive awards for saving cyclist in cardiac arrest
stories.summary: Kip Knowles collapsed in cardiac arrest while cycling alone, and three school staff members intervened promptly. PE teacher Stacey Charman, cookery teacher Chellie Messenger, and school nurse Claire Agnew performed CPR for 25 minutes. Their actions, which included using a defibrillator, revived Kip before medical help arrived. Kip’s wife nominated the trio for awards from St John Ambulance for their lifesaving efforts.

stories.title: A Florida chimpanzee sanctuary cut off by flooding; uses drone to deliver food to a stranded chimp
stories.summary: A chimpanzee named Kaleb faced isolation during heavy flooding at Save the Chimps sanctuary. Staff utilized a drone to deliver essential food and blankets to him safely. The floodwaters disrupted normal delivery routes, which required creative solutions to ensure animal welfare. By using trucks and a drone, caregivers managed to keep the animals fed and healthy, despite the challenges.

stories.title: NCPCR set to finalise guidelines for responsible, safe use of social media by children
Stephen Miller makes his first big decision, internal memo reveals something Susie Wiles would have never approved: Report
'I am under house arrest': Sonam Wangchuk speaks out against restrictions on movement in Ladakh
RFK Jr faces probe over 'anti-vaccine' activism during 2019 Samoa visit
Tennessee county to pay $1 million to veteran Tasered by deputy in 2022
stories.summary: Knox County, Tennessee, has agreed to pay $1 million to Brian Eugene Hux, a 64-year-old disabled Air Force veteran who suffered a fractured skull and brain bleed after being Tasered by a deputy in 2022. The settlement follows a federal appeals court ruling that denied the deputy qualified immunity.

stories.title: 39 Discoms come under CAG scanner to ringfence projected Central investment of Rs 3 lakh cr
‘Don't care if they bulldoze me’: Abhishek Banerjee on demolition of structure outside his residence

Tanker with 19 Indian seafarers on board attacked off UAE; all safe: Shipping minister
'They lied about my mother for years': Priyanka Gandhi hits back at BJP over Sonia's memoir
'I would’ve not gone forward': Biden says he would have dropped out of 2024 race if he knew about cancer
Google, Microsoft & more: Valuation of firms led by Indian CEOs hits $15 trillion
stories.summary: A wave of Indian-origin business leaders is reshaping the global corporate landscape, amassing an impressive collective valuation of $15 trillion. The rise of artificial intelligence has been instrumental in this growth, with 103 out of the 200 companies listed in the HSBC Hurun Global Indians List 2026 leveraging AI technology.

stories.title: ‘Stop them or face double tariffs’: Trump warns Mexico as 1,500 migrants head towards US
Tennessee court upholds $575,000 award to UPS driver injured in 2022 crash
stories.summary: A Tennessee appeals court has upheld a $575,000 compensation award to a UPS driver injured in a 2022 rear-end collision. The driver said his permanent shoulder injury could affect his ability to continue working and reduce his future earnings. The court rejected challenges by the other driver and his employer, finding sufficient evidence to support the jury's award.

stories.title: Life Of Violet Jessop: stewardess survives Titanic and Britannic; keeps sailing for decades
stories.summary: Her work brought her into contact with the rapidly expanding transatlantic shipping industry, where ocean liners were increasingly associated with luxury, speed and international travel. In 1911, she joined the White Star Line and began working aboard the RMS Olympic.

stories.title: Jimmy Carter's family sells 2,500 acres of Georgia farmland for conservation
'Attempts to instigate public': Sonam Wangchuk faces 60-day restrictions on movement in Leh amid opposition to polls
Evening newswrap: Owaisi and Azad join hands for 2027 UP polls; Nvidia board weighs Huang's exit amid spy scandal, and more
stories.summary: AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi and MP Chandrashekhar Azad have joined forces to create the Samajik Parivartan Morcha in anticipation of the 2027 UP elections. With Azad as the designated chief ministerial candidate, this coalition invites partnerships with both the Samajwadi Party and Congress for enhanced political representation. Concurrently, retail inflation has reached 6.09%, breaching the RBI's upper threshold, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's situation is under scrutiny amid relationship claims.

stories.title: Everyone wanted a Labubu. What happened?
stories.summary: Once a coveted collectible, Pop Mart's Labubu dolls are now witnessing a steep decline in desirability, particularly in the United States. Recent sales data reveals a dramatic fall in global revenue, resulting in collectors becoming increasingly discerning. As enthusiasts pivot towards new toy brands and characters, many are reevaluating their investments in Labubu dolls, signaling a pivotal shift in the collecting landscape.

stories.title: Former Yankees manager Joe Torre's childhood inspires charity for abused children
stories.summary: Former New York Yankees manager Joe Torre and his wife Ali founded Safe At Home in 2002. The charity now runs 30 school-based programmes offering counselling and safe spaces to children affected by domestic violence and trauma.

stories.title: Rare 24-carat Bulgari pink diamond sells for over $14.6 million at Christie's Geneva auction
stories.summary: The Bulgari Pink, a stunning 24-carat pink diamond, fetched a remarkable $14.6 million at a recent auction. This exquisite gem, with roots tracing back to the 1950s, is prized not only for its beauty but also its provenance from the legendary Golconda mines in India. Such sales underscore a persistent fascination among collectors for rare and unique colored diamonds, highlighting the luxury market's focus on both rarity and heritage.

stories.title: 'BJP's team': Congress takes swipe at AIMIM-Azad Samaj Party alliance ahead of UP polls
Leave Texas, come to Florida: Congressman invites Elon Musk to shift base, says 'Sunshine State' does not investigate or punish success
Punjab polls: AAP releases second list of 31 candidates
Uttar Pradesh elections 2027: Who will Owaisi-Azad alliance hurt most? Explained in 5 charts
stories.summary: The Owaisi-Azad alliance Samajik Parivartan Morcha will attempt to bring Dalits, Muslims and backward communities together could eat into the Samajwadi Party's PDA support base, challenge Mayawati's hold over Dalit politics and complicate the BJP's electoral calculations. With Chirag Paswan also eyeing an expansion in UP, the 2027 assembly contest could see multiple players competing for overlapping caste constituencies.

stories.title: 'Finally, some good news': Two sisters of ex-Pak PM Imran Khan released from jail
Ted Turner's family to auction 20 Montana ranch paintings estimated at $20 million for conservation cause
stories.summary: Ted Turner's family is set to auction 20 exquisite paintings by renowned 19th-century American artists, aiming to benefit the Turner Foundation. This collection, showcasing breathtaking landscapes of the American West, carries both cultural and financial significance. The auction, planned for January 2027, underscores Turner's commitment to philanthropy and environmental causes, with proceeds directed towards conservation projects that preserve vital natural habitats.

stories.title: Colin Cowdrey’s son wins £500,000 neighbour dispute over £3.85 million home
Samuel L. Jackson, wife honoured by charity that has helped 50,000 families affected by autism, Parkinson's
stories.summary: Samuel L. Jackson and LaTanya Richardson Jackson received the Clarence and Jacqueline Avant HollyRod Humanitarian Award at a charity gala. The event recognized their humanitarian efforts and contributions to supporting families affected by autism and Parkinson's disease. Hosted by Holly Robinson Peete and Rodney Peete, the gala focused on raising funds and awareness for the challenges these families face.

stories.title: Father charged after baby found buried alive in dog crate
stories.summary: An 11-month-old infant named Koah Sharp was discovered alive after being buried in a dog crate. His father, Michael Comer, has been charged with attempted murder after the search lasted for 24 hours. Rescuers found Koah underground, which helped him survive due to cool temperatures and an air pocket. Authorities were alerted when his grandmother reported him missing shortly after she left him with his father.

stories.title: Woman killed, man injured as rival militant groups exchange gunfire in Manipur
PM Modi to visit Manila for ASEAN Summit from November 16 to 18
Punjab-origin newlywed couple and brother-in-law killed in NZ crash; families seek repatriation
'Don't assume you can swallow Kashmir with such attacks': Farooq Abdullah targets Pak
stories.summary: Omar Abdullah expressed concerns about ongoing terrorism in Jammu and Kashmir during a recent statement. He criticized the government's belief that terrorism has ended, arguing that it is still a pressing issue. Abdullah urged Pakistan to end terrorism and focus on dialogue as a viable solution. Following attacks, two special police officers were found dead, highlighting the region's violence.

stories.title: Court rejects Virginia couple's claim over highway expansion near their home
stories.summary: A Virginia appeals court has rejected a couple’s claim for additional compensation over an I-495 highway expansion, ruling that they could seek damages only for the temporary easement taken from their property, not losses linked to the wider road project. Their expert had estimated that the project could reduce the property’s value by nearly $500,000.

stories.title: 15-year-old Canadian hockey player reaches $50,000 cancer treatment fundraising goal
Made-in-India 5G Radio Moves Closer To Market, Bulk Supplies Expected In 2027
Govt mulls special session to pass women’s quota amendment bill: Report
People free to protest against Congress: Priyanka Gandhi on police action against Kerala protesters
'Sad day for democracy': Bombay HC warns against criminalising constitutional right to protest
stories.summary: The Bombay high court has overturned an FIR against Nishkarsh Nimgade, highlighting the fundamental constitutional right to peaceful assembly during his protest over poor road conditions in Chandrapur district. The court recognised this right as vital to the democratic fabric and stated that criminal charges shouldn't stifle non-violent protests. Sparked by an accident linked to these conditions, the court condemned the prosecution of Nimgade as a misuse of legal resources.

stories.title: Indian-origin trucker Ranjit Singh found guilty of smuggling 40kg cocaine worth $4.8m into Canada
After NEET row, NTA invites retired defence personnel to monitor exams
Meet 'Popeye': Pablo Escobar's hitman who claimed involvement in 3,000 killings before becoming a YouTuber
stories.summary: Jhon Jairo Velásquez, infamously known as 'Popeye', served as a notorious hitman under drug lord Pablo Escobar, reportedly carrying out over 250 murders, including numerous high-profile hits. After 23 years of incarceration, he turned to social media fame with his YouTube channel 'Repentant Popeye,' where he ruminated on his violent past and critiqued governmental actions. Sadly, he succumbed to oesophageal cancer in 2020 following a short imprisonment.

stories.title: 'Can't wait for firing to stop': Farooq Abdullah bats for India-Pakistan talks despite twin terror attack
Sam Pitroda praises PM Modi, receives Diwali wishes; X user's cheeky request gets a reply
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended Diwali and Gujarati New Year greetings to Congress leader Sam Pitroda after the latter spoke warmly about their personal equation. The exchange took an amusing turn when an X user asked for festive wishes too, prompting a response from the Prime Minister.

stories.title: India must create, not just adopt inventions: Narayana Murthy calls for respect, better pay for teachers & researchers
stories.summary: NR Narayana Murthy emphasized the need for India to foster innovation and respect for educators and researchers. He outlined a four-stage model of economic development related to invention and innovation. While India has made progress in certain areas, it still lags in many aspects affecting citizens' lives. Investment in education and training of teachers is crucial to elevate the country’s innovative capacities.

stories.title: The Australian in Indira's Tihar compound: When Sonia Gandhi carried lunch for Charles Sobhraj's accomplice
stories.summary: On Christmas Day in 1978, Sonia Gandhi brought a homemade lunch to Tihar Jail for her mother-in-law. Indira Gandhi, a former Prime Minister, was imprisoned during a turbulent political period. The meal was extended to include prison guards and a fellow inmate related to a notorious killer. Despite resistance, Sonia felt compelled to keep family traditions alive during this difficult time.

stories.title: Owaisi, Azad announce alliance for UP polls; send message to Akhilesh
stories.summary: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi and Nagina MP Chandrashekhar Azad formed an alliance named Samajik Parivartan Morcha. They intend to challenge the BJP in the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Azad will be the chief ministerial candidate, aiming to unite marginalized communities for greater political representation. The alliance invites other parties, like the Samajwadi Party and Congress, to join in this effort.

stories.title: Arvind Kejriwal, daughter Harshita get death threats from Bishnoi gang; Rs 7 crore demanded
After 27 years, nurse Karen Barlow retires; memorable moments are parents holding sick children's hands
stories.summary: Karen Barlow marks the end of a remarkable 27-year journey with the Royal Flying Doctor Service in Australia. Her dedication to providing vital medical assistance to those in isolated regions is commendable. Barlow not only offered solace during treacherous medical flights but also fostered strong connections with families in crisis. Among her memorable moments, she met King Charles and Queen Camilla.

stories.title: Researchers recorded three Sistan sand boas in Rajasthan's Sikar district
stories.summary: In a groundbreaking discovery, three Sistan sand boas have been identified in Sikar district, Rajasthan, a first for the nation. Researchers pointed out unique characteristics that set this species apart from the Indian red sand boa. Interestingly, these snakes inhabit urban and agricultural regions, deviating from their usual sand dune habitats.

stories.title: Kulgam CRPF attack: Manhunt intensifies for LeT affiliated terrorist Md Lateef Bhat
stories.summary: Security agencies are intensifying their manhunt for local terrorist Mohammad Lateef Bhat in the Kulgam area. Suspected in a recent assault on CRPF personnel, Bhat has a notorious reputation for orchestrating Over Ground Worker networks. His connections to several terror incidents have alarmed officials. Previously, he dodged arrest during a confrontation with security forces in Shopian. Local authorities urge citizens to assist in tracking him and the other fugitives.

stories.title: Bullet-riddled bodies of 2 missing police officers found in J&K's Kishtwar
'No room for Taiwan independence': Xi Jinping doubles down on reunification push
G7 Warns Over China Moves: ministers say Taiwan actions threaten stability; raises blockade fears
stories.summary: The G7 foreign ministers have collectively addressed China's growing assertiveness in the waters off Taiwan's eastern coast. They emphasized the critical need to sustain both peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait. Concerns were raised over possible militarization and maritime activities by China that could jeopardize regional security and disrupt international shipping.

stories.summary: FSSAI says it will help consumers identify dairy products

stories.title: Pope Calls Peru Homeland: Leo begins emotional arrival in Lima; Peruvians look to pope for answers
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV's arrival in Lima marks a significant moment, as he acknowledges Peru's influence on his pastoral path. With strong personal connections to the nation, he seeks to tackle pressing issues like poverty and crime. Amid ongoing political uncertainty, the pontiff's visit brings hope, encouraging many Peruvians to engage in various activities designed to foster community and address vital social matters.

stories.title: India slips 5 spots on climate change index
stories.summary: India has experienced a decline in the Climate Change Performance Index, falling from prior high rankings. The country now sits at 28th position due to rising greenhouse gas emissions and energy use. While India has made significant strides in renewable energy, the overall performance remains low. Comparatively, Pakistan, with lower emissions, is ranked just above India at 26th.

stories.title: Pollution's hidden health cost: Dirty air may also raise diabetes risk, global review finds
stories.summary: Recent findings highlight a concerning connection between PM2.5 air pollution and an increased risk of type 2 diabetes, showing that every 10 microgram per cubic meter rise in PM2.5 could boost diabetes risk by 10% to 16%. Notably, South Asian communities, particularly in India and Bangladesh, may face a 9% heightened risk. This underscores the urgency for improved air quality management to mitigate metabolic diseases, although definitive causation remains unestablished.

stories.title: Did China use a 'honeypot' to influence Nvidia CEO? US Congress wants answers
stories.summary: US lawmakers have raised national security concerns over Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's alleged relationship with a woman suspected of links to Chinese intelligence. Congressman Jamie Raskin and Senator Chuck Schumer have questioned the potential Chinese influence, while Nvidia's board has launched an investigation and is reportedly considering Huang's future amid growing controversy.

stories.title: Nvidia-linked suspected Chinese spy Alice Huang now living in Beijing: Report
Netanyahu asks military to prepare for Iran 2.0; opp says no strikes before next gov
stories.summary: Amid rising tensions, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's security cabinet has initiated military preparations for a possible strike on Iran. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot advocates for careful judgment from the caretaker administration during this transitional period, emphasizing that military actions should only be executed in the face of direct threats to Israel. He highlights concerns about Netanyahu's decreasing support in the Knesset, which currently stands at just 46 votes.

stories.title: Centre looks to open up car-rental market, cuts proposed minimum fleet to five
Cenat Reassesses Online Fame: Streamer sets new boundaries with fans; Vivet fashion label grows
stories.summary: Kai Cenat is rethinking his relationship with fame as he learns to set boundaries with his millions of followers. In a new VIBE interview, the 24-year-old streamer discussed stepping away from streaming, protecting his personal life and recognising the responsibility that comes with his influence. He also reflected on his 2023 Union Square controversy and discussed expanding his career through his fashion brand, Vivet.

stories.title: Texas woman wins $100,000 legal-fee award in backyard office dispute with HOA
Texas court overturns ruling against estate seeking to withdraw claims over disputed property deed
stories.summary: In a contentious case involving allegations of forgery against Malachite Venture Corporation, the Texas First Court of Appeals ruled in favor of Doctor R.K. Dhingra's estate, allowing it to withdraw its claims. This decision overturned the trial court's earlier ruling, reinforcing that plaintiffs can withdraw claims before a judgment is reached, despite Malachite's objections regarding its counterclaims.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai India's cleanest city, Indore's domination ends
stories.summary: For the 2025-26 Swachh Survekshan Awards, Navi Mumbai has claimed the esteemed title of the cleanest city. Following closely are Surat and Vijayawada, securing the second and third positions, respectively. Additionally, Rewa from Madhya Pradesh has been honored as the cleanest riverfront town this year. Significant mentions include Rudrapur as the cleanest Himalayan city, along with various award categories highlighting different city populations.

stories.title: Scientists discover uncounted right whale calf off Canada, bringing season's total to 24 amid population of 380
stories.summary: In a remarkable development, scientists have confirmed the sighting of a previously unrecorded North Atlantic right whale calf near Quebec, bringing this season's total to 24, the highest since 2009. Researchers believe the calf's mother, Silt, gave birth in the warmer waters of the southeastern U.S. Despite this positive news, the North Atlantic right whale population remains critically endangered, with an estimated 380 individuals.

stories.title: KISS star Gene Simmons cuts Beverly Hills mansion price by $2.5 million
Collegium wants transfer of HC judges streamlined, random ways discarded
stories.summary: The Supreme Court collegium is working to establish a systematic policy for transferring judges among high courts. Currently, transfers are largely subject to personal criteria, which the collegium aims to revise. This new policy emphasizes objective reasoning to streamline the transfer process, reduce personal biases, and enhance accountability regarding judges’ conduct and expertise, marking a pivotal evolution in judicial integrity management.

stories.title: SC: Indians married here can't get divorced abroad
stories.summary: In a landmark decision, the Supreme Court declared that divorces executed overseas, based on grounds not acknowledged under Indian law, are invalid. This ruling implies that individuals who remarry after such foreign divorces may risk prosecution for bigamy. The court also affirmed that marriages conducted according to Indian traditions hold validity, irrespective of any foreign citizenship.

stories.title: Complete data could've raised average Diwali pollution level in Delhi by 49%
stories.summary: On Diwali night, the absence of PM2.5 data from monitoring stations led to distorted pollution readings in Delhi. Research by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air indicated that pollution levels might have increased by as much as 49%. While the Central Pollution Control Board pointed out calibration limitations, readings from the Delhi Pollution Control Committee were inconsistent.

stories.title: Ohio man challenges $23,161 share after co-owner gets $171,635 from property sale
stories.summary: An Ohio appeals court dismissed a man's challenge to his $23,161 share of property sale proceeds after the money was distributed. Randall Petersen argued that the lower court had failed to account for his mortgage payments and other contributions. However, the court said he could not continue the appeal because he had not obtained a stay on the payment.

stories.title: Keanu Reeves seeks restraining order after intruder leaves DNA kit at LA home
Yuge Yugeen museum set to open doors to public next year; cabinet approves Rs 3,230 cr
NTA plans exam centres in every district
On Diwali, why worry about bad air, it'll improve on own: Yogi Adityanath
North Dakota Supreme Court upholds 19 make-up weekends after mother withholds children from father
stories.summary: The North Dakota Supreme Court has upheld the contempt ruling against Christa Sandstrom, primarily due to her actions that blocked Courtney Krueger from accessing court-ordered parenting time. To remedy this, Krueger has been awarded 19 weekends to make up for lost parenting time. The court also denied Sandstrom's petition to change the existing parenting arrangements, emphasizing the need for compliance with court directives regarding parenting time.

stories.title: After 17 years, California pier walk raises record $3.3 million with celebrity supporters in 2026
stories.summary: The Skechers Pier to Pier Friendship Walk has become an essential event in Southern California's charity scene. In 2026, it achieved a remarkable milestone by raising $3.3 million to aid children with special needs. This annual gathering also plays a crucial role in public education and scholarships, assisting students at all levels. With the Friendship Campus opening in January 2027, support for neurodivergent young adults is set to expand significantly.

stories.title: Study Links Climate And Violence: Peru skeletons show low conflict; ritual sacrifice stays distinct
stories.summary: Throughout history, ancient communities in Peru's Lambayeque Valley confronted significant flooding and food scarcity. Interestingly, despite these hardships, instances of interpersonal violence were notably infrequent. Research indicates that only a tiny percentage of skeletal remains revealed signs of conflict. Instead, these resilient societies cleverly adapted, capitalizing on marine resources to weather environmental challenges.

stories.title: Cong MP in sex abuse row on Manipur poll panels
Confident of trade pact ahead of PM Modi's trip: Canada envoy
stories.summary: Christopher Cooter, Canada’s high commissioner to India, expressed hope for the imminent finalization of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. This agreement aims to bolster trade relations ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's scheduled visit next month. Cooter emphasized that new international student policies focus on eliminating fraudulent schools while still welcoming legitimate Indian student applications.

stories.title: Blacklisted Chinese military-linked university bought Nvidia H200 chips - Report
Green energy push helped India save $100bn over last 15 yrs: IEA
stories.summary: India's remarkable leap in renewable energy capacity has led to over $100 billion in reduced costs for coal and natural gas imports. With 300GW of renewable power, the nation stands as the second-fastest-growing market worldwide. The International Energy Agency estimates that by 2030, cumulative savings could soar to $240 billion.

stories.title: ‘SOS’ call from Ladakh leaders & Wangchuk, to President, PM and HM for poll deferment
Geelani’s granddaughter Ruwa Shah likely to join PDP
Pennsylvania mother-daughter property feud ends with $245,568 in court awards
3 CRPF men wounded as terrorists strike patrol in south Kashmir
Two vulnerable short-tailed albatrosses raise five chicks as their offspring return to Midway Atoll
stories.summary: In an inspiring twist, George and Geraldine celebrate their 10th consecutive breeding season at Midway Atoll. Over the years, they have raised no fewer than five chicks, with some of their young returning recently. This is a promising sign for a breeding population that is considered Vulnerable. Continued conservation efforts hold the key to potentially establishing a new haven for short-tailed albatrosses on the island.

stories.title: UP polls: Owaisi, Azad likely to announce alliance on Nov 12

Amanda Seyfried says her nine-year-old daughter watched 'Mean Girls' for the first time last year and loved it
stories.summary: Amanda Seyfried opened up about her daughter's honest reactions to her films, particularly 'Mean Girls'. While Nina appreciated Seyfried's acting, she found the film lacking in humor. Having also seen 'Mamma Mia!', she recognized her mother's musical talent. Seyfried plans to share her upcoming film 'Steps', which explores complex relationships, showcasing the unique viewpoints children have of their celebrity parents and how those views evolve over time.

stories.title: Iran unveils underground 'missile city', warns US of strikes across region & beyond
stories.summary: Iran revealed a large underground military facility that contains various ballistic and cruise missiles amidst ongoing tensions. Senior military officials warned of potential attacks on American forces if conflicts resume, highlighting Iran's preparedness. The facility has been described as a missile city, showcasing its advanced military capabilities. Significant political leaders emphasized the need for the US to recognize Iran's conditions to resolve conflicts.

Louisiana court restores man's will leaving entire estate to wife after six children challenge it
stories.summary: A Louisiana appeals court restored a 2015 will that left a man's entire estate to his wife after six of his nine children challenged its validity. The judges ruled that the children had failed to prove that the document did not meet the state's revised requirements for notarial wills. The case has been sent back to the trial court for further proceedings.

stories.title: Star-Studded Encino Mansion Relist: Meghan Trainor seeks $17.995 million; Zedd, Joe Jonas among past owners
stories.summary: Meghan Trainor and Daryl Sabara have put their Encino mansion on the market for a staggering $17.995 million. Acquired just two years ago from Zedd for $17.125 million, this luxurious property has a rich celebrity lineage, previously owned by Joe Jonas and Sophie Turner. Boasting opulent features such as a recording studio and a private gym, it's yet to be determined if they'll achieve their asking price.

stories.title: Microplastics may be changing the colour of the Pacific Ocean
stories.summary: Research indicates that microplastics in the Great Pacific Garbage Patch may be changing ocean color. This change creates a subtle blue-green tint that satellites have detected over twenty years. Scientists analyzed how microplastics affect light scattering and absorption and compared it with natural materials. Future studies will require optical measurements from the patch for confirmation. Preventing microplastics from entering oceans is critical to reducing their impact.

stories.title: Canadian retiree wins $50M Lotto Max after delaying ticket check to “keep the dream alive"
stories.summary: After a thrilling wait, Shaun Ryan from Dalhousie, New Brunswick, celebrated winning the massive $50 million Lotto Max jackpot. Putting off ticket validation for a few days to relish the suspense, Ryan ultimately checked his numbers. He envisions using the prize to aid his extensive family and fulfill his wife's travel dreams post-teaching.

Lollapalooza grants Chicago schools $1.7M for arts education through 2031

'Two 8-year-olds or four 4-year-olds': Pak cleric's child bride 'joke' sparks outrage

However, after legal deliberations, an appeals court overturned the initial ruling that declared the will invalid, citing insufficient evidence from the challengers. This ruling paves the way for the succession process to proceed under fresh legal stipulations.

stories.title: Jane Seymour refuses to leave Malibu home despite repeated wildfire scares
12-year-old girl who could barely swim survived Yemenia plane crash, clung to wreckage in Indian Ocean for hours

Bahia Bakari, a brave 12-year-old girl, astonishingly survived by clinging to the wreckage for nearly 13 hours before being rescued by a sailor enduring harsh conditions. Upon recovery, she faced the heartbreaking news of her mother's death from a psychologist.

Official confirmation comes from the Rare Breeding Birds Panel, celebrating this achievement from 2024. Additionally, various wetland bird populations are witnessing positive trends in breeding. Ongoing observation by bird enthusiasts will be crucial in ensuring future breeding achievements and maintaining population stability.

UK PM Burnham vows to unveil 10-year plan for Britain before Christmas amid Badenoch's vision jibe

Hidden for nearly five decades, these coins were acquired by a man who chose to keep his investment secret from his family during the economic struggles of the 1970s. The bidding war, fueled by interest from collectors and investors, ultimately provided substantial financial relief to his widow.

Tiffany Haddish's charity gives 2,000+ suitcases yearly to foster youth, inspired by her childhood

The charity distributes thousands of suitcases yearly to children in need, collaborating with prominent brands such as Samsonite for high-grade products. Beyond luggage, the foundation focuses on career development and mentorship, with recent programs including a film project that allowed participants to learn production skills and express their creativity.

stories.summary: A family from San Jose has triumphantly secured an $8 million jury award after a protracted legal battle with their neighbor. The neighbor had alleged that their autistic child's vocalizations posed a public nuisance to her work life. The family argued that these sounds were a natural part of their child's condition.

stories.title: Tech executive wins $2.75M after woman breaks $97K settlement deal with public assault claims
stories.summary: Michael Fitzgerald has been awarded $2.75 million after Ronda McNae breached a confidentiality agreement. Despite having settled with him earlier, McNae's public accusations of serious misconduct violated their pact. The court determined her actions severely harmed Fitzgerald's professional image and caused significant financial losses. The appeals court confirmed the lower court's ruling, emphasizing the impact of McNae's defamatory claims on Fitzgerald's career.

stories.title: Jimmy Carter's 2,458-acre family farm in Georgia acquired for conservation; wildlife area to expand to 7,000 acres, public access planned from 2027
stories.summary: The Conservation Fund has acquired the Carter family farm to protect it as wildlife habitat. Plans include opening the property to the public for outdoor activities before its state transfer. This acquisition will expand the nearby Lanahassee Creek Wildlife Management Area, enhancing conservation efforts in Georgia. The Carter family, recognizing its historical significance, supports the preservation initiative for future generations.

‘I am safe, receiving treatment’: President’s bodyguard Saurabh Tomar after being shot in UP

Meseret Shiferaw, who tragically lost three children in the 2017 crash, raised claims of negligence involving the insurer's handling.

stories.title: 'Congress leaders in Punjab must break silence': Sukhbir Badal on Sonia Gandhi's 'clean chit' to 'killers of Sikhs'
National Conference's twin troubles: Can Farooq Abdullah contain brewing revolt against Omar?
stories.summary: The National Conference party, under Omar Abdullah's leadership, finds itself in a quagmire as veteran MLAs express dissatisfaction over recent cabinet decisions. In a bid to stabilize the situation, Farooq Abdullah strives to reconnect with restless lawmakers while examining their issues. The recent resignation of Srinagar MP Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi underscores the growing ideological splits.

stories.title: Jeremy Renner’s former Hollywood Hills land becomes $99M mansion
stories.summary: A luxury mansion in Los Angeles has been relisted for $99 million after a significant price reduction. Previously priced at $125 million, the property has undergone a substantial adjustment to attract buyers. The mansion features seven bedrooms, 12 bathrooms, and spans 22,000 square feet on over an acre of land. It also includes amenities like private access to Runyon Canyon and a 100-foot infinity pool.

Harry Styles' tote bag moment raises $40K for charity, funding 1,300 therapy sessions
stories.summary: Photographed in London, Harry Styles carried a tote bag linked to a cause close to the heart—mental health support. Founded by Elena Kilgore, The Other People Fund provides essential therapy sessions for individuals in need. Initially kicking off as a small clothing project, the initiative garnered remarkable attention from Styles' fanbase, raising an impressive $40,000, equating to around 1,300 affordable therapy sessions.

'95% suffer, 5% exploit': Akhilesh says UP polls no longer '80-20' in dig at BJP
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav has accused the BJP of creating divisions among the people of Uttar Pradesh. He claims that the political contest has shifted from an 80-20 to a 95-5 divide. Yadav has raised concerns regarding alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and suggests metal voter identity cards for transparency. He asserts that the previous SP government initiated key metro projects which have not expanded much under the BJP.

Sheikh Hasina, water and trade: Roadblocks in India-Bangladesh ties
Ladakh bans protests ahead of polls: Sonam Wangchuk warns of fresh agitation against elections
'Architect of INDIA bloc': JD(U) rejects Sonia Gandhi's remarks on Nitish Kumar in memoir
From Shah Bano to 1999 Congress revolt over foreign origin: 5 political moments in Sonia Gandhi’s memoir
stories.summary: Sonia Gandhi's memoir unveils the intersections of her personal life and political career. Delving into episodes like the Shah Bano case and the Babri Masjid events, she offers poignant reflections on her husband Rajiv Gandhi's assassination and its aftermath. Furthermore, she candidly shares the hurdles faced during her Congress leadership amidst internal strife, creating a rich narrative about India's political evolution.

stories.title: Fake notices in Delhi Police's name sent to X to block 2 accounts, FIR registered
Late-arriving grooms put on notice as Kashmir's wedding chefs set 10 pm deadline for wazwan
stories.summary: Kashmir's wedding chefs, known as waza, have unanimously decided to stop serving food after 10 pm. They have cited long working hours and poor treatment as reasons for this decision. Working conditions have become difficult due to extended delays from guests, particularly the groom's arrival. Chefs have reported insufficient arrangements for rest during long hours of work. The community advocates for more dignified working conditions and timely wedding practices.

stories.title: 'Babar premis will be punished': BJP targets TMC's Kirti Azad over Ram Mandir remarks
stories.summary: BJP spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari criticized TMC MP Kirti Azad for his recent comments regarding Lord Ram and Ayodhya. Bhandari accused opposition parties of engaging in vote bank politics while expressing disdain towards Hindu sentiments. Azad claimed he would not visit the Ram Mandir and questioned Lord Ram's treatment of Maa Sita. The controversy arises ahead of Akhilesh Yadav's proposed visit to the temple in December.

‘Stolen donations, betrayed faith’: Congress seeks SC-monitored probe against BJP, RSS over Ram Temple funds
Kenan Thompson, Luis Guzman host New York gala for childhood brain cancer charity that has donated over $4 million

stories.summary: Bob Cavallo undertook a significant renovation of a Nichols Canyon home initially intended for a family member. Originally built in 1988, the house underwent extensive updates to cater to contemporary buyers. These enhancements included transforming a dumbwaiter shaft into an elevator for better accessibility. Post-renovation, the property was listed at nearly $5 million. Cavallo's expertise in music management notably shaped his vision for real estate development.

stories.title: New giant bird species identified 17 years after discovery
stories.summary: Researchers have identified a new extinct species of ground-dwelling bird, Megapodius rokusi, from a fossil. This fossil, a leg bone, was discovered in Liang Bua cave on Flores Island, Indonesia. It represents the first megapode fossil found in the region called Wallacea, indicating new insights into ancient bird species. The study suggests that the bird was much larger than today's living relatives.

The memo was circulated ahead of President Trump's visit to China in May. Although US officials alerted Trump about Huang’s connections, no action was taken, and Huang was invited on the trip. This situation has raised alarms over Huang's role in shaping AI policies and decisions affecting Nvidia.

Coded calls from Brooklyn jail: How Iran operative directed terror plots in Europe, US
stories.summary: A US indictment alleges that an Iran-backed operative jailed in New York used coded calls with family members to coordinate a plot against RAF Fairford, a British air base housing US troops. The accused and two associates are also alleged to have planned nearly 20 attacks targeting Jewish communities across Europe and the US.

‘Unfit to remain in office’: Eisenkot attacks Netanyahu after ‘hateful’ Knesset speech
stories.summary: Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party cancelled a meeting with Netanyahu's Likud party after his controversial speech. Eisenkot criticized Netanyahu for his divisive and unfit behavior during the Knesset swearing-in ceremony. Netanyahu continues to advocate for a unity government while rejecting ties with Arab parties. The political landscape remains fragmented with no party holding a clear majority in the Knesset.

stories.title: US army officer arrested in UK on suspicion of spying for Russia
stories.summary: A US army officer serving with Nato's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps was arrested near Gloucester in England on suspicion of espionage linked to Russia, British police said. The 41-year-old suspect faces allegations of assisting a foreign intelligence service and obtaining or disclosing protected information. The arrest comes amid growing European concerns over Russian covert operations, sabotage and espionage targeting Nato countries.

stories.title: Nvidia hires top US law firm to investigate affair between CEO Huang and Chinese spy
stories.summary: Nvidia has engaged the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to probe allegations against CEO Jensen Huang, who is implicated in a case involving a suspected Chinese spy named Alice Huang. While Jensen has acknowledged a personal relationship with Alice, he firmly denies any involvement in espionage. The FBI has also launched a separate investigation, but Nvidia reassures all stakeholders that trade secrets and national security remain intact.
